name: Martin Wood
bio: Martin Wood is a Canadian television and film director and producer, best known for his work on the science fiction series "Stargate SG-1" and the spin-off "Stargate Atlantis", as well as the mystery show "Sanctuary". He has also directed for many other television movies and series', including "Killjoys", "When Calls the Heart", and the "Aurora Teagarden Mystery" franchise.
